report.verdict: A senior backend engineer with a notable ledger project, but little about the work in recent jobs.
write_up: You're a senior backend engineer working on payouts and ledger services. It's common to see a default headline and a thin job description, but a recruiter may move on when they can't tell what you did on those services.

The strongest detail is in Projects: ledger-recon is an open-source Go library with 1,200 GitHub stars, used by three payment companies. That's a much more memorable introduction than the adjectives in your About section.

Start with the Northwind Pay job: name what you worked on and what changed. Then bring ledger-recon into your About and sharpen the headline. That would give someone hiring for backend payments work a better reason to write to you.
